nodes.description: Unique identifier for the insured property or location number
Full street address of the insured property
City or town where the insured property is located
Postal or ZIP code of the property
County or parish for regional risk analysis
Country of the property, jurisdiction of coverage
Insured value of the building structure, replacement cost
Value of contents or business personal property in the building
Business income or business interruption value, loss of rents
Use or purpose of the building, residential commercial industrial
Construction type or material, frame masonry steel concrete
Number of floors or stories of the building
Total count of buildings at the location
Whether fire sprinklers are installed, Y N Y13 Y(13R)
Other insured values not building or contents, outdoor property

nodes.text: Number of Buildings must be at least 1.
Sprinkler code must be Y, N, Y13 or Y(13R).
Reference must be unique per row.
